title: convert/1: what `file convert` converted, or would convert
description: The document of `mzlab-cli file convert --json` and of `--report FILE`. With `--dry-run` (`dry_run` true) nothing is written and each item says what would be converted: `input`, `output`, `sample_id` (null for a dataset with one sample), `reader` (null when no reader takes the dataset), `input_bytes`, `empty`. Otherwise each item is a result: `{input, output, sha256, spectra, seconds, skipped, ...}` or, for a file that failed, `{input, error, cause}`; `conversion` is the conversion/1 record read back from the mzML head. Seconds are wall-clock seconds. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/convert.rs, convert_report.rs.

skipped.description: True when the file was taken from the cache.

error.description: The error key of a file that failed.

rename.description: Why the file is not called by its plain name: a name equal to another input's case aside (position prefix `K-`), or with `--name sample` a clash, an unsafe or an empty sample name; absent when the file has its plain name.
